This is the first beta release of MechWarrior 2 Enhanced Renderer Mod. It is a
hobby project built for the DOS v1.1 release of *MechWarrior 2: 31st Century
Combat*, keeping the original game in charge while replacing the in-mission 3D
presentation with an experimental OpenGL renderer.

**Supported platform:** Windows x64 on Intel or AMD 64-bit hardware. Linux,
Wine, and Windows ARM64 are not supported.

## Highlights

- High-resolution and widescreen mission rendering with 4x supersampling.
- Switch between the original and enhanced renderers at any time, or view them
  side by side.
- A scalable widescreen HUD, steadier cockpit motion, crisper instruments, and
  faithfully reproduced startup, shutdown, damage, video-interference, and
  satellite-uplink animations.
- Enhanced imaging retains textured explosions, weapon effects, jump-jet
  puffs, flags, and other billboards instead of placeholder geometry.
- Full render distance, improved model LOD selection, reduced terrain seams,
  motion-blurred helicopter rotors, smoother mech camouflage, and improved
  dropship panel detail.
- HOTAS axis mapping, calibration, response curves, inversion, and a live input
  preview in the configurator.
- 60 and 72 FPS frame-pacing profiles, plus a fix for jump-jet fuel recharge at
  higher frame rates.

## Installing

Download `mw2-enhanced-renderer-mod-v0.9.0-windows-x64.zip`, extract it, and
follow the included README. You must supply your own installed DOS v1.1 game
directory and `.bin`/`.cue` CD image. No MechWarrior 2 files are included.

The package bundles dosbox-x-mod v0.2.0 and its own Python runtime; players do
not need to install Python, uv, or DOSBox-X separately.

## Beta limitations

- Full render distance may interfere with or reveal parts of some missions
  earlier than intended.
- Frame rates above the supplied 60 and 72 FPS profiles can break LRM missiles.
- Pressing `Esc` during a mission can occasionally terminate it with an
  `divide overflow` error.
- Mission resource preloading may cause cache pressure in some missions.
- The enhanced renderer does not yet reproduce the game's fill lighting or
  damage-based brightening of mechs and other objects.
- A few terrain seams and smaller rendering differences remain.

Reports of major reproducible issues are appreciated. This is beta-quality
software, so please keep your original game installation and saves backed up.
